practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: 21-day IR practice window open (Week 1); awaiting current-week practice ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Incoom's calf injury is severe enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve. As such, the Central Michigan product will be required to miss at least four games, so the next time he can suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Bam Martin-Scott was activated from IR in a corresponding move.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 89% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.

practiceReport.name: Jonathon Brooks
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 3); logged Full Participation in prior week's ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Brooks was a full practice participant in all three sessions during Week 11 prep. However, the third-year running back is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, and he's slated to miss his eighth consecutive game while recovering from a groin injury. Trevor Etienne, Anthony Tyus and AJ Dillon will continue to operate as the Panthers' backfield depth options behind Chuba Hubbard in the absence of Brooks, whose next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Buccaneers on Monday, Nov. 30.

practiceReport.name: Tetairoa McMillan
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (82% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (82%)
Beat/podium consensus (2 corroborated reports): on track to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: McMillan didn't partake in Wednesday's unofficial practice, after which Canales revealed that the wide receiver dealt with soreness in his foot after Sunday's win against the Ravens in which he hauled in six of nine targets for 71 yards and one touchdown. Considering the Panthers likely are practicing Wednesday in lieu of a session on Thanksgiving, McMillan appears likely to be listed as a DNP on the team's first Week 12 injury report Thursday.

practiceReport.name: Mike Jackson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (77% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Jackson was designated to return from injured reserve Wednesday and has practiced in full since then. He was listed as questionable to suit up versus Baltimore, though he is now cleared to play for the first time since Week 3.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Brady Christensen
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 5 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Christensen has been rehabbing from a hamstring injury all year, but he was not activated from IR within 21 days of returning to practice, so he'll now miss the rest of the season. The veteran guard will now have to look forward to hopefully returning at some point in 2027.

irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Brooks was a full practice participant in all three sessions during Week 11 prep. However, the third-year running back is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, and he's slated to miss his eighth consecutive game while recovering from a groin injury. irAndReserveTracker.name: Thomas Incoom
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Incoom's calf injury is severe enough for him to warrant a stint on injured reserve. As such, the Central Michigan product will be required to miss at least four games, so the next time he can suit up is Week 11 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 22. Bam Martin-Scott was activated from IR in a corresponding move.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jaycee Horn
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Horn is currently considered day-to-day, but head coach Dave Canales wants to ensure Horn is in a great head space before returning. The 2021 first-round pick has been sidelined since late September, while Chau Smith-Wade has handled slot-cornerback duties in his absence. The Panthers will still have to officially activate Horn off injured reserve before he's eligible to return.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Isaiah Simmons
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Simmons will be required to miss at least the next four games for Carolina. He's logged just six defensive snaps this season and another 206 on special teams.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Akayleb Evans
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Evans is dealing with a triceps injury, and he was unable to practice at all this week ahead of being ruled out for Thursday night's contest versus Green Bay. The 27-year-old will now be forced to miss at least four games while on IR, and in his absence, Will Lee, Malcolm DeWalt and Chau Smith-Wade will stand to operate as the team's primary options at cornerback.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Ikem Ekwonu
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Ekwonu was placed on the Panthers' reserve/PUP list prior to the start of the regular season, as he was still recovering from the ruptured patellar tendon he suffered during the Panthers' wild-card loss against the Rams last postseason, and there's no indication at this point that he's nearing a return. With rookie first-rounder Monroe Freeling now dealing with a knee issue, Stone Forsythe could be called upon to start at right tackle for the Panthers in Week 6 after their bye in Week 5.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Cam Jackson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Jackson will miss the remainder of the campaign after undergoing shoulder surgery. He was also nursing a knee injury and will now shift his focus to getting healthy for the 2027 campaign.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Chris Brazzell II
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Knee) on Jul 31, 2026; ineligible to return in 2026 under NFL CBA rules.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Nic Scourton
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Scourton tore his ACL during the first practice of training camp, ending his 2026 season before it began. Cam Gill was added to the roster in the wake of Scourton's injury. The Panthers will also continue to monitor the edge-rusher market for additional help at the position.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Taylor Moton
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Moton fractured his fibula in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday. The offensive tackle will likely miss the rest of the 2026 season due to the injury, making the move to injured reserve a formality. Monroe Freeling is set to start at right tackle for the Panthers for the remainder of the season.
